item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of moving parts, and water is the easiest thing to drop when you're busy. Dehydration quietly dulls focus and mood, and it makes stress feel heavier than it is. Don't wait for thirst. Spread your water across the day, with a glass at each transition and one with every meal. Right now, fill a large bottle and put it where you'll see it.
